names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 decembrie, «Sfântul Proroc Naum», with the rank word left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Δεκεμβρίου, «Προφήτης Ναούμ», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 1. децембар ст. ст., „Свети пророк Наум.“ — «Свети» is “saint” and not a rank and «пророк» is the `prophet` grade this corpus keeps in `types`, so both come off and the bare personal name is the whole of the form; the heading gives him no epithet, where the Greek life calls him the Elkesite. `foldchk.py` measured the string as held in ru by `naum-of-aglomazovo`, a martyr of 1918, so this form makes a two-folder fold and the key is in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs`.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (25 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 1 decembrie — «Sfântul Proroc Naum»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Προφήτης Ναούμ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it is the same prophet, the Elkesite of the twelve minor prophets whose book is against Nineveh. Of its five hymns the first Ἀπολυτίκιον and the Κοντάκιον are taken here; the «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον», the Μεγαλυνάριον and the Κάθισμα are not drafted. A piece of his relic, the page says, is at the monastery of Simonopetra on the Holy Mountain.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 14.12.2025 (1. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети пророк Наум.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry and the first of two, both of them upgrades and neither a new folder. The menologion scan put seven folders on 1/12 in another calendar and this is the prophet the Romanian and Greek calendars already keep on their own 1 December. Quoted whole with its closing full stop (section 4); URL year 2025, as `sr-civil.mjs` gives for the Julian 10-20 to 12-18. `types` UNTOUCHED: «пророк» is the `prophet` the folder already holds, and «Свети» is “saint” and not a rank. `dates` REPLACED, AND THIS IS THE ONE READING ON THE DAY THAT CHANGES A RECORDED FACT. The folder held `floruit` 460 BC to 460 BC off saint.gr, «άκμασε περί το 460 π.Χ.»; this book says «Живео на седам стотина година пре Христа», seven hundred years before Christ, which is two and a half centuries earlier. CORPUS.md section 3 is explicit that two sources disagreeing are recorded as an interval carrying both readings and that nothing is chosen, so the floruit is now 700 to 460 BC with both pages quoted in the note; `basis` stays `traditional` and the folder is unlocated, so `map-span.test.mjs` is not in play. No `locations`: Елкесем and the Jordan are named and neither is a coordinate the reader may set. ONE PERSON NAMED AND HE ALREADY HAS A ROW: Јона, `jonah-the-prophet`, who is in `related` both ways already and whose preaching is the whole point of this entry. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion. THE FOLD THIS FORM MAKES: `foldchk.py` measured «Наум» as held in ru by `naum-of-aglomazovo` alone, so this form makes it a two-folder fold and a key is in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in the same commit; there was nothing narrower to delete.

hymns.text: A prorocului Tău, Doamne, Naum, pomenire prăznuind, printr-însul Te rugăm, mântuieşte sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Proroc Naum; the common of a prophet, with his name set into it

english.text: Keeping the memory of your prophet Nahum, O Lord, through him we entreat you: save our souls.

hymns.text: Τοῦ Προφήτου σου Ναοὺμ τὴν μνὴμην, Κύριε ἑορτάζοντες, δι᾽ αὐτοῦ σε δυσωποῦμεν· Σῶσον τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος β’ — the first of the two apolytikia on the page of «Προφήτης Ναούμ», and it names him. The page gives it a tone and no automelon.

english.text: As we keep the memory of your prophet Nahum, O Lord, we entreat you through him: save our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς πυρσὸς ἀκοίμητος Ναοὺμ Προφῆτα, φρυκτωρεῖς ἐν πέρασι, δι’ αἰνιγμάτων ἱερῶν, τὴν τῶν μελλόντων ἀλήθειαν, ὧν τὰς ἐκβάσεις ὁρῶντες τιμῶμέν σε.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον — the kontakion on the page of «Προφήτης Ναούμ», and it names him.

english.text: Like a beacon that never sleeps, O prophet Nahum, you signal to the ends of the earth, through sacred riddles, the truth of things to come; and seeing their outcomes we honour you.

floruit.note: Two books disagree and neither is chosen (CORPUS.md section 3). saint.gr: «Έζησε τον 5ο αιώνα προ Χριστού (άκμασε περί το 460 π.Χ.) και ήταν από τη φυλή του Συμεών»; the Охридски пролог for 1. децембар ст. ст.: „Живео на седам стотина година пре Христа.“
